title: Consumer Reports: Truth about extended vehicle warranties
summary: Consumer Reports says extended auto warranties rarely pay off and recommends saving the money and buying a reliable car instead.

assertions.quote: Consumer Reports has found that buyers aren't always gonna see return on that investment
a better plan would be to take whatever money you would spend on an extended warranty instead put that in an emergency fund
focusing on buying a car with a better-than-average predicted reliability rating and then of course properly maintaining it

verdicts.note: Reliability ratings predict fewer major repairs, which directly lowers the odds a warranty would ever pay out.

assertions.quote: the price which remember can be negotiated just like the price of the car
